sheets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Gemwoven RPG inventory icon evolution atlas. Match the previously shown game item reference's polished clean HD painted fantasy style: bold clear silhouette, jewel-like highlights, dark fine contour, rich warm metallic shading, readable at small icon size. Do NOT draw characters or hands. Exact landscape 3:2 canvas, three columns and two rows of equal square invisible cells (3 columns x 2 rows). Each object centered at its own cell center; entire object including glow occupies only central 64% of its cell; wide transparent gutters all around. Read cells in order top-left, top-middle, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-middle, bottom-right. The first FIVE cells contain FIVE EVOLUTION FORMS of the same relic, each clearly a different design with the same identity. SIXTH cell bottom-right stays completely EMPTY AND TRANSPARENT. No visible grid, no borders, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no UI tiles, no backgrounds, no floor, no shadow plate. Genuine transparent alpha background. All silhouettes complete and isolated; no glow, tassel, energy, wing or ornament may cross a cell boundary. Compact attached glow only in forms 4 and 5. Same three-quarter front view for all icons. Relic identity: Tan the humble brown-clothed wood-sword traveler's JOURNEY COMPASS, round navigational compass with a simple arrow needle, warm wood, brass and green accents; no alphabet compass letters. Cell1 simple small wooden compass with plain green needle and leather loop, no jewels or effects. Cell2 same compass with substantial bronze protective rim and two little folded metal corner brackets, no gems. Cell3 ornate gold-rim compass with four small emerald gems and engraved eight-point star needle, visibly upgraded. Cell4 awakened compass with pair of compact golden feather wings attached at sides, emerald center and two concentric mechanical rings. Cell5 transcendent adventure astrolabe, distinct layered star compass inside golden orbit rings with four short luminous emerald wing fins and a restrained warm golden halo behind it, majestic yet perfectly contained.
